MY.period: 2024 inbound visitor arrivals; 2023 outbound holiday survey
MY.label: Historical visitor markets and surveyed outbound holiday destinations
MY.note: Inbound counts include same-day visitors and overnight tourists. Outbound destinations are from a Tourism Malaysia respondent survey conducted in February–March 2024 about 2023 overnight holiday trips; China and South Korea tied at 4.6%. These are different measures and are not November/December 2026 predictions.

ID.label: Historical monthly visitor nationalities and outbound destinations
